verdict.rationale: Morph publishes a first-party coding-agents guide: Claude Code runs through its native Anthropic Messages endpoint at /v1/messages, and Codex can be given an `edit_file` tool backed by morph-v3-fast. It also documents an MCP integration guide and a quickstart step that installs the Morph MCP for Claude Code. A goose author reports using it in practice. missing for 10: documented first-party guides for agent frameworks (e.g. SDK/orchestration frameworks beyond OpenAI-SDK compatibility), broader independent hands-on corroboration of the integration guides themselves.
